config.note: Event/rule coverage may be zero until the next annotation pass; this gate verifies installation, hash, and quality labels.

limitations: Single-annotator labels; future difficult examples should be double-reviewed.
Paywall stratum is source-level known/likely status because row-level paywall was unavailable.
Public article text is truncated and URL query strings are removed.

maintenance.append_only_default: Prefer adding a new versioned dataset/manifest over silently rewriting old labels.
maintenance.history: Keep prior eval_history metrics so threshold movement is explainable.
maintenance.label_change_rule: Changing an existing label requires annotation_notes explaining why.
maintenance.refresh_cadence: Refresh or extend the dataset after major scoring/dedupe/event/rule changes, or monthly during active eval work.

agent_sampling_brief: In the production PIM environment, export around 500 recent diverse candidates across at least 10 sources.
Use scripts/export_eval_candidates.py with blank labels; do not invent final labels automatically.
Run scripts/prelabel_eval_candidates.py only to add suggested_* review hints.
Create a TSV or HTML review sheet with scripts/review_eval_candidates.py; ask the human to confirm/fix labels.
Apply the reviewed sheet with --require-reviewed, then validate/install the JSONL and write a manifest.
If event/rule fields are unavailable, leave coverage in the manifest as zero/pending instead of fabricating fields.

coverage_targets.event_grouping: Prefer event_id/event_key when available; report as pending if the production model has not landed yet.
coverage_targets.fulltext_quality: metadata.fulltext_status/fetch_acceptance must be present across the set.
coverage_targets.rule_coverage: Prefer rule_id/rule_matches/keyword_matches when available; report as pending if rules are not yet exported.

labels.must_see: High-signal item a good daily brief should surface.
labels.noise: Duplicate, low-signal, promotional, irrelevant, or poor-quality extraction.
labels.ok: Relevant or useful, but not necessarily a top daily item.

maintenance_policy.append_only_default: Prefer adding a new versioned dataset/manifest over silently rewriting old labels.
maintenance_policy.history: Keep prior eval_history metrics so threshold movement is explainable.
maintenance_policy.label_change_rule: Changing an existing label requires annotation_notes explaining why.
maintenance_policy.refresh_cadence: Refresh or extend the dataset after major scoring/dedupe/event/rule changes, or monthly during active eval work.

privacy_rules: No cookies, API keys, auth headers, browser storage, private tokens, or runtime secrets.
No private emails, chat logs, personal notes, or non-public user identifiers unless irreversibly redacted.
Full content must be truncated to the export limit and should only include content the user is allowed to process locally.
Keep source attribution, title, timestamps, and URL so eval failures remain debuggable.
sample_standard.purpose: Shared, de-identified, human-reviewed quality eval for PIM scoring, fulltext quality, near-duplicate behavior, and future event/rule coverage.

sampling.method: deterministic label-stratified split of a 500-row production review set

split_policy.formal: remaining 400 rows, never used by the bootstrap fixture
